Name: Least Chipmunk - Eutamias minimus
Habitat: Sagebrush deserts, coniferous forests, mixed-hard
woods. Highly varible.
Foods: Insects (50% in warm months), seeds and fruits. Wheat, sedge, gooseberry, cinquefoil, ragweed,
buffaloberry, dandelion, brmegrass, sunflower, sage-
brush, goosefoot.
Thirteen-lined Ground Squirrel - Citellus tridecem-Name: lineatus
Habitat: Clear areas, deserts, plains.
Foods: Grasshoppers, other insects, mice, birds, carrion, ragweed, sunflower, clover, wheat, needlegrass, Russian thistle.
Name: Richardsons Ground Squirrel - Citellus richardsoni Habitat: Sagebrush, grasslands.
Foods: Grasshoppers, caterpillars, mice, birds, carrion, goose foot, bluegrass, dandelion, sunflower, cinquefoil.
Name: Norhtern Pocket Gopher - Thomomys talpoides Subterranean in praries, meadows, open pine Habitat: forests, brushy areas.
Foods: Roots, bulbs, rootstocks, seed, nuts; most plants that grow near the burrow.
Miscellaneous: May cause damage to some crops. Cause problems with irrigation waters.
Olive-backed Wyoming Pocket Mouse - Perognathus Name: fasciatus
Habitat: Shortgrass prairies.
Foods: Locoweed, pigweed, fiscue, saltbush, bromegrass, bindweed, sunflower, playtain, barley, Russian thistle, saltbush.
Name: Ord's Kangaroo Rat - Dipodomys ordii Habitat: Plains, praries on sandy soil. Foods: Pigweed, saltbush, ragweed.
Name: Beaver - Castor canadensis
Habitat: Streams, rivers, lakes, marshes with trees, and b brush available for cutting.
Foods: Bark and wood, main diet. Willow, pine.
Miscellaneous: Pelts valuable at times. May cause damage through dam building activities.
Name: Western Harvest Mouse - Reithrodontomys megalotis Habitat: Grasslands, open deserts, weed patches, near water. Foods: Insects and seeds.
